qualification.details: The applicant must be a bona fide resident (मूल निवासी) of Rajasthan. No specific educational qualification is prescribed for the Safai Karmchari post. The applicant must have at least 1 year of experience of sanitation (safai) work in any urban local body of the state. This experience can be continuous for 1 year, or accumulated across separate periods totalling 1 year. Candidates must be of good mental and physical health, free of any defect that would hinder efficient discharge of duties; a health certificate from the Chief Medical & Health Officer or a medical jurist of their district of residence is required if selected, and police verification will be conducted on final selection.

according to the number of advertised posts in each urban local body
Priority 1: Candidates with 1 year of sanitation experience in the same urban local body they are applying to. Priority 2: If posts remain unfilled after Priority 1
candidates with 1 year of sanitation experience in another urban local body within the same district are included in the lottery. Priority 3: If posts still remain unfilled
candidates with 1 year of sanitation experience in any urban local body anywhere in the state are included in the lottery.
how_to_apply: Visit the Local Self Government Department portal, https://lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in/, or the SSO Rajasthan portal, https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in.
Log in to the SSO portal and select the Recruitment Portal under Citizen Apps (G2C), then click Apply Now.

If not already registered, complete One Time Registration (OTR) by selecting your category (Unreserved/Reserved: EWS/OBC-NC/MBC-NC/SC/ST/SAH), disability status if applicable, and home state, and pay the applicable OTR fee.
Once OTR is complete, apply through the SSO portal for the recruitment; information entered during OTR (name, father's name, date of birth, gender) cannot be changed at this stage.
Fill in all required details in the online application form, upload the required documents, capture a live photograph, and upload your scanned signature as per the specified format.
Select your preferred urban local body (only one ULB can be selected) and confirm all entered details before final submission.

Submit the application and note the Application ID generated after submission - if no Application ID is received, the application has not been successfully submitted (a Preview is not considered a submission).
Retain a printout of the submitted application form for future reference and document verification.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmchari Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates are advised not to wait for the last date and to apply within the given time frame. All certificates/documents must be issued before the last date of application; documents issued after this date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmchari Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The vacancy count is ULB-wise (निकायवार) and may increase or decrease as per requirement. Candidates can apply to only one urban local body of their choice among the 183 notified; applying to more than one ULB results in rejection of all applications by that candidate. Only local/bona fide residents of the Scheduled Area of Rajasthan can apply for posts under the Scheduled Area category, and must clearly mark the "Scheduled Area" column in their online application; candidates who don't mark this column will not be considered for these posts.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmchari Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: As per the Rajasthan Contractual Hiring to Civil Posts Rules, 2022, an applicant must have attained a minimum age of 21 years and must not have exceeded 40 years, as calculated on 1 January 2027 (the first 1 January following the last date of application). These age relaxations are non-cumulative - a candidate can avail the benefit of only the single relaxation most favourable to them, not a combination of more than one provision.

rows.upper_age_relaxation: No upper age limit (must be below the government retirement age of 60 years)
10 years, as per Rajasthan Civil Services (Ex-servicemen Absorption) Rules, 1988, and related orders
5 years, as per Rajasthan Divyangjan Adhikar Niyam, 2018

rows.category: Persons repatriated from Pakistan during the 1971 India-Pakistan war
Existing state/panchayat/PSU employees serving on a substantive basis

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmchari Educational Qualification / Eligibility
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a bona fide resident (मूल निवासी) of Rajasthan. No specific educational qualification is prescribed for the Safai Karmchari post. The applicant must have at least 1 year of experience of sanitation (safai) work in any urban local body of the state. This experience can be continuous for 1 year, or accumulated across separate periods totalling 1 year. The 1-year experience certificate must be issued by the concerned urban local body, in the prescribed proforma, and must be issued after 1 August 2026 and before the last date of application (28 September 2026) to be considered valid. Candidates must be of good mental and physical health, free of any defect that would hinder efficient discharge of duties; a health certificate from the Chief Medical & Health Officer or a medical jurist of their district of residence is required if selected, and police verification will be conducted on final selection.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmchari Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is made through a lottery system (developed by the Rajasthan Department of Information Technology & Communication) among eligible candidates, category-wise, according to the number of advertised posts in each urban local body, in the following priority order: Priority 1: Candidates with 1 year of sanitation experience in the same urban local body they are applying to. Priority 2: If posts remain unfilled after Priority 1, candidates with 1 year of sanitation experience in another urban local body within the same district are included in the lottery. Priority 3: If posts still remain unfilled, candidates with 1 year of sanitation experience in any urban local body anywhere in the state are included in the lottery.

content_sections.text: Candidates must complete a One Time Registration (OTR) on the SSO portal before applying, for which the following registration fee applies. Candidates who have already paid the OTR registration fee previously do not need to pay again.

content_sections.heading: Rajasthan Safai Karmchari Reservation Policy 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, and Economically Weaker Section candidates follows applicable state government notifications. Most Backward Class (Ati Pichhड़ा Varg) candidates get 5% reservation as per state notification dated 13.02.2019. Economically Weaker Section (EWS) candidates get 10% reservation as per state notifications dated 19.02.2019 and 20.10.2019. Sahariya Adim Jati candidates of Baran district get reservation benefit only if they clearly mark the relevant column in their application; otherwise they are treated as General category. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS categories from states other than Rajasthan are treated as General category candidates for this recruitment. Reservation for dependents of regular Urban Local Body employees (serving/retired/deceased) is governed as per applicable company/department rules. If suitable and eligible candidates are not available for EWS-reserved posts, those posts will be filled through the normal (General) process as per rules. If a candidate has already availed any other concession/rebate (such as an age relaxation) alongside a reservation category fee benefit, they will not be considered for the unreserved fee category.

rows.reservation: 30% horizontal reservation; adjusted proportionately within each women candidate's own category
15%, as per Rajasthan Civil Services (Ex-servicemen Absorption) Rules, 1988
2%, as per state government notification dated 21.11.2019

4%, as per Rajasthan Divyangjan Adhikar Niyam, 2018 (covers low vision, deaf/hard of hearing, locomotor disability, autism, intellectual disability, learning disability, mental illness, and multiple disabilities, per the notified categories)

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Rajasthan Safai Karmchari Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Aadhaar Card / Jan Aadhaar Card (details recorded during OTR - name, father's name, date of birth, gender - cannot be modified later; ensure Aadhaar details are correct before OTR) 1-year sanitation work experience certificate in the prescribed proforma, issued by the concerned urban local body after 1 August 2026 and before the application deadline Caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC/MBC candidates), issued by a competent authority in the prescribed format EWS Income & Assets Certificate, in the prescribed format, for candidates claiming EWS reservation Disability certificate / UDID card (for Divyangjan candidates), verified as per Karmik Department circular dated 06.08.2025 Live photograph (captured live during the application, not uploaded from gallery, with a plain white/light background, face clearly visible without shadow, cap, or dark glasses) Scanned signature/thumb impression (within a 7 cm rectangular box, JPEG format only, 20 KB–50 KB file size)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process closes on 28 September 2026 at 11:59 PM. Candidates are advised not to wait for the last date.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are there in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 24,752 posts of Contract Sanitation Worker (Sanvida Safai Karmachari) are advertised across 183 urban local bodies, comprising 24,277 posts in non-scheduled areas and 475 posts in scheduled areas.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary of a Safai Karmachari in Rajasthan?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly honorarium of Rs. 7,410/-, as per the Labour Department notification dated 13 December 2024.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 21 years and not more than 40 years of age as on 1 January 2027, with age relaxation available for reserved categories, women, ex-servicemen, and persons with disabilities as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there a written exam for Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. Selection is made entirely through a computerised lottery system; there is no written examination or interview.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualification is required for this post?
faq.answer: No specific educational qualification has been prescribed for the Safai Karmachari post.

faq.question: Q7. Is prior work experience mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have at least 1 year of sanitation work experience in any urban local body of Rajasthan, supported by a valid experience certificate issued after 1 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the OTR registration fee for Rajasthan Safai Karmachari Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: The One Time Registration fee is Rs. 600/- for general/unreserved candidates and Rs. 400/- for reserved category and Divyangjan candidates. Candidates who have already paid this fee earlier need not pay again.
